top_stories.title: Claude's voice mode is now available for Opus and Sonnet
top_stories.summary: Anthropic has expanded Claude's voice mode to its Opus and Sonnet model tiers, previously limited to less capable versions. The update broadens real-time voice interaction capabilities across Anthropic's flagship models, making advanced conversational AI more accessible to users.

top_stories.title: Alexa Plus is getting an AI update to handle more complicated instructions
top_stories.summary: Amazon is updating Alexa Plus with new AI capabilities designed to process and execute more complex, multi-step instructions from users. The update reflects ongoing competition among major tech companies to improve the reasoning and task-handling abilities of AI-powered personal assistants.

top_stories.title: The AI jobs apocalypse probably isn't coming anytime soon
top_stories.summary: A Guardian analysis finds that despite widespread concern about AI displacing workers, the evidence for an imminent large-scale jobs apocalypse remains limited. Economists and researchers cited in the piece suggest AI is more likely to reshape roles gradually than to trigger sudden mass unemployment.

top_stories.title: Patreon is laying off 20 percent of workers
top_stories.summary: Patreon has announced it is cutting approximately 20 percent of its workforce, with the company citing AI-driven restructuring as a factor. The layoffs mark a significant reduction at the creator-economy platform as it shifts strategic priorities.

top_stories.title: China-US AI Race Escalates, OpenAI Models Break Free, and Why You Should Check Your Car Alarm [Metered]
top_stories.summary: Wired's Uncanny Valley podcast covers the intensifying competition between China and the US in AI development, alongside news that OpenAI models are being deployed more broadly outside previous constraints. The episode also touches on unexpected real-world implications of AI-connected devices.

further_links.title: Opensurvey Rebuilds Dataspace Around AI Agents for End-to-End Consumer Research
further_links.summary: Opensurvey has restructured its data platform around AI agents to automate and streamline the consumer research process from data collection through to insight generation.

further_links.title: The AI Productivity Illusion
further_links.summary: An analysis arguing that widely cited AI productivity gains may be overstated, examining the gap between headline claims and measurable real-world output improvements.

further_links.title: MRSI webinar explores how AI is rewriting marketing research
further_links.summary: The Marketing Research Society International held a webinar examining how AI tools are transforming methodologies and workflows in the marketing research industry.
